measured.basis: Each constant is 1.25 x the largest value measured over every overlapped generated-schedule run on the validated_for hosts (7 per template on the M2, 9 per template on the M4 Max CI runner), rounded up to 1 MiB, so the envelope's own margin is 1.0. The prepare charge (generation_peak_bytes + 8 MiB + compile_peak_bytes) covers this template's prepare, from the start of generation to the end of the compile (largest 27.0 MiB, an M4 Max run; the M2's largest is 23.3 MiB). The two Supertonic vocoder templates compile the same program with the same weights, so load_peak_bytes.all, the resident part and the compiler reserve are taken over both templates' runs: load_peak_bytes.all covers the load and warm-up increment (largest 49.4 MiB, an M4 Max run that held a weight-sized copy in the process; the other runs stay under 10 MiB); the resident part (weight.bin's size, twice the I/O and workspace_bytes) covers the steady state from the load start (largest 49.8 MiB, the same run); and ane_compile_reserve_bytes is 1.25 x ANECompilerService's largest absolute size while loading on any validated host (531.9 MiB, on the M4 Max; the M2's largest is 297.9 MiB). No run found the service clean (it held 74-244 MiB before every M2 load and 374-490 MiB before every M4 Max load), so its growth (at most 53.0 MiB) would understate a cold compile on a clean host, and its absolute size is the conservative basis.
